title: DS-1…DS-6 - Deesys Square Type Current Transformer 1.15 kV, busbar through
description: Deesys square type current transformers for panel metering, busbar-through construction, rated up to 1.15 kV, for indoor use. Brown ABS non-flammable case with polyester mould. Primary ratings from 100 A (DS-1) up to 6000 A (DS-6), secondary 5 A or 1 A.

feature_groups.title: Main Feature
items: Colour: brown; case: ABS non-flammable resin; mould: polyester
Mounting metal makes busbar installation easy

rows: DS-1 : primary 100 / 150–200 / 250–300 / 300 A, burden 5 or 15 VA, class 1.0 %, weight 1.3 kg
DS-2 : primary 400 A (burden 15 VA) and 500–600 A (burden 15–40 VA), class 1.0 / 0.5 %, weight 1.5 kg
DS-3 : primary 600–1000 A, burden 15–40 VA, weight 1.5 kg
DS-4 : primary 750–2000 A, class 1.0 %, weight 1.6 kg
DS-5 : primary 1000–4000 A, burden 40 VA, class 0.5 %, weight 1.9 kg
DS-6 : primary 2500–6000 A, class 0.3 %, weight 4.8 kg
